content.text: Now let me validate redlines for the deviations found.

input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a sole-and-exclusive supplier obligation, and this clause contradicts Sections 2.1 and 12.3, so we have deleted it. If Vendor needs protection we could discuss exclusivity limited to a defined product category for 12 months, ending automatically if Vendor misses service levels.

[Playbook] We do not give most-favoured-customer undertakings to suppliers, and this clause is inconsistent with Section 12.3, so we have deleted it. MFN pricing running in our favour remains welcome.

ops.oldText: Customer shall pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day as agreed liquidated damages for any delay in providing a dependency.
ops.newText: If Customer materially delays a dependency identified in an Order Form, Vendor is relieved of the affected obligations and dates for the period of delay and may recover its documented, reasonable additional time-and-materials costs actually incurred as a result. No liquidated damages or penalties are payable by Customer.

input.comment: [Playbook] We do not pay liquidated damages or penalties; USD 25,000 per day for any dependency delay is punitive and uncapped. We have replaced it with schedule relief plus Vendor's documented additional costs, which is the standard remedy for customer-caused delay.
input.summary: Replace Customer-payable liquidated damages with schedule relief and documented costs.

ops.oldText: unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice
ops.newText: unless either Party gives thirty days' advance written notice before the end of the then-current term, and Vendor shall remind Customer of the upcoming renewal at least sixty days before it occurs

input.comment: [Playbook] A 180-day non-renewal window is far longer than we can operate; our position is a 30-day opt-out with a 60-day Vendor reminder (fallback: 60 days). The 12-month renewal term and the Section 8.3 uplift cap of the lesser of CPI and 3% are acceptable.
input.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice from 180 to 30 days and add renewal reminder.
